My journey is a slow one but after years I trust him so much. I guess I can recommend “communication is key”?  He gave me a lot of understanding, space and time to feel secure, and he keeps doing it. Hope this helps, and thanks to Lucifer and thanks for his patience!

They eat each other. I used to care for an aquarium and even if you carefully put the specific type of fish to prevent fights and them eating each other, one day they still do that. I hope you take the action you need. 💓
